methodology: To perform the analysis, I systematically decomposed both the original research topic and the generated technical specification into atomic units. Each unit represents a distinct, self-contained requirement or behavior, ensuring clarity and specificity.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Lemmings can walk left or right.
Lemmings switch directions upon encountering obstacles.
Lemmings fall when there is no ground.
Digging takes precedence over switching directions.
Lemmings splatter if falling for more than 20 clock cycles.
FSM includes an asynchronous reset signal to initialize the state to walking left.
spec_atomic_units: The module defines the interface for a combinational logic circuit.
Inputs include clk, areset, bump_left, bump_right, ground, and dig.
Outputs include walk_left, walk_right, aaah, and digging.
The Lemming switches walking direction upon bump inputs.
The Lemming enters a falling state when ground is 0.
The Lemming starts digging when dig is 1 and ground is 1.
Falling has the highest precedence, followed by digging, then walking.
The FSM initializes to walking left upon reset.
